sessions.transcript: Alice Chen joined Nebula Cloud as Tech Lead for Project Nova. Project Nova initially runs on MongoDB 6 and deploys to AWS us-east-1.
Bob Patel owns the AuthService microservice. AuthService uses Redis Cluster for session caching and JWT RS256 for tokens.
Carol Lin leads the BillingEngine team. BillingEngine integrates Stripe v2025 API and settles invoices in USD.
Project Nova grew into Project Atlas and migrated its primary database from MongoDB 6 to PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector.
Project Atlas depends on AuthService for SSO and uses BillingEngine for metered usage billing. David Kim manages DevOps and maintains Terraform EKS.
Project Atlas migrated hosting from AWS us-east-1 to Cloudflare Workers with AWS eu-central-1 backend. Terraform EKS now runs Kubernetes 1.31.
Incident INC-402 hit AuthService due to Redis Cluster failover timeout; Bob Patel replaced Redis Cluster with Valkey 8.0 and switched tokens from JWT RS256 to EdDSA Ed25519.
Elena Ortiz joined as Security Lead and oversees ZeroTrustPolicy. ZeroTrustPolicy requires EdDSA Ed25519 on AuthService and SOC2 audit logs in ClickHouse.
BillingEngine upgraded payment_gateway from Stripe v2025 to Adyen Enterprise and added EUR alongside USD. Carol Lin handed BillingEngine over to Frank Wu.
Carol Lin took over as Director of AI Platform, leading the VectorGateway service written in Rust Axum. VectorGateway stores embeddings in Qdrant.
Project Atlas adopted VectorGateway for semantic search and upgraded its database to PostgreSQL 17 with pgvectorscale. Terraform EKS upgraded to Kubernetes 1.32.
ACME Corp became the flagship enterprise customer on Project Atlas with a 99.99% SLA backed by PagerDuty escalation to Alice Chen and David Kim.
